en_us: Botany Pots, tiers, soils and hoppers, and trees in pots.
es_es: Botany Pots: niveles, suelos, tolvas y árboles en maceta.

hover.en_us: Back to the Sun of Heliodor

en_us.title: A farm in a pot
en_us.subtitle: Farming, apartment edition.
text: [lead] Soil, seed and a corner of the shelf: no field needed.
A [item:botanypots:terracotta_botany_pot|Botany Pot] is a [item:minecraft:flower_pot|Flower Pot] ringed by [hl|5] terracotta.
[icon:right_click] Right-click it to load soil, seed and tool. Right-click a grown one to harvest.
{page}
Every pot comes plain, with a hopper or waxed.
[big|61] materials: terracotta in 17 colours, glazed and concrete in 16 each, and twelve kinds of brick.

es_es.title: Una granja en una maceta
es_es.subtitle: Agricultura, versión departamento.
text: [lead] Tierra, semilla y un rincón del estante: sin campo.
Una [item:botanypots:terracotta_botany_pot|Maceta botánica] es una [item:minecraft:flower_pot|Maceta] rodeada de [hl|5] terracotas.
[icon:right_click] Clic derecho para cargarle tierra, semilla y herramienta. Sobre una crecida, cosecha.
{page}
Cada maceta viene simple, con tolva o encerada.
[big|61] materiales: terracota en 17 colores, vidriada y hormigón en 16 cada una, y doce tipos de ladrillo.

sources: jar:botanypots-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.44.jar:assets/botanypots/lang/en_us.json#block.botanypots.* (183 blocks: 61 materials x plain, hopper, waxed)
jar:botanypots-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.44.jar:net/darkhax/botanypots/common/impl/block/BotanyPotBlock.class#useItemOn (basic pot: right-click harvests a ready crop)

en_us.title: First harvest
en_us.subtitle: Sixty seconds of patience.
text: [lead] Soil and a seed in, a crop out.
[li] Top slot, soil: [item:minecraft:dirt|Dirt] will do.
[li:minecraft:wheat_seeds] Second slot, seed: [item:minecraft:wheat_seeds|Wheat Seeds].
Wheat is ready in [hl|60] seconds.
{page}
[note] Each crop sets its own time: trees take [hl|2] minutes, sculk two to five.

es_es.title: Primera cosecha
es_es.subtitle: Sesenta segundos de paciencia.
text: [lead] Tierra y semilla adentro, cosecha afuera.
[li] Ranura de arriba, tierra: alcanza con [item:minecraft:dirt|Tierra].
[li:minecraft:wheat_seeds] Segunda ranura, semilla: [item:minecraft:wheat_seeds|Semillas de trigo].
El trigo está listo en [hl|60] segundos.
{page}
[note] Cada cultivo trae su tiempo: los árboles tardan [hl|2] minutos, el sculk de dos a cinco.

en_us.title: Hopper pot
en_us.subtitle: The pot that harvests itself.
text: [lead] It harvests on its own and hands the crop to whatever sits below.
[li] Shapeless: a [item:minecraft:hopper|Hopper] and a pot.
[li] Or the quick recipe: the hopper in the pot's top gap.
[li] Twelve slots hold the harvest.
[careful] Full slots lose the new harvest. Put a container under it.

es_es.title: Maceta con tolva
es_es.subtitle: La maceta que se cosecha sola.
text: [lead] Cosecha sola y le pasa el cultivo a lo que tenga abajo.
[li] Sin forma: una [item:minecraft:hopper|Tolva] y una maceta.
[li] O la receta rápida: la tolva en el hueco de arriba.
[li] Doce ranuras guardan la cosecha.
[careful] Con las ranuras llenas se pierde la cosecha nueva. Ponele un contenedor abajo.

sources: jar:botanypots-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.44.jar:net/darkhax/botanypots/common/impl/block/entity/BotanyPotBlockEntity.class#tickPot (only the hopper pot harvests by itself and exports to the inventory below)
repo:docs/design/resource-farm-runtime-cases.md#slots 0 soil, 1 seed, 2 tool, 3-14 stock; full stock loses the new harvest

en_us.title: Elite Upgrade
en_us.subtitle: Act III, in white trim.
text: [lead] A white band on the pot and triple the work.
[big|×3] speed, [big|×3] harvest.
[li] Two [item:minecraft:iron_ingot|Iron Ingots] flanking a [item:entrelumen:propagation_core|Propagation Core].
[li] Sneak-click it on a placed pot: the contents stay.
[note] The core is an act III delivery: [quest:exchange_nursery|Seeds of Continuity].
{page}
The tooltip says Speed [hl|2] and Multiplier [hl|2]. They add to the base [hl|1]: the pot runs at ×3, so wheat takes [hl|20] seconds.
[tip] A whole new pot takes the upgrade, [hl|5] terracotta, [hl|2] iron ingots and a plain pot.

es_es.title: Mejora Elite
es_es.subtitle: Acto III, con ribete blanco.
text: [lead] Una franja blanca en la maceta y el triple de laburo.
[big|×3] velocidad, [big|×3] cosecha.
[li] Dos [item:minecraft:iron_ingot|Lingotes de hierro] a los lados de un [item:entrelumen:propagation_core|Núcleo de propagación].
[li] Clic agachado sobre una maceta puesta: el contenido se queda.
[note] El núcleo es una entrega del acto III: [quest:exchange_nursery|Semillas de continuidad].
{page}
El tooltip dice Velocidad [hl|2] y Multiplicador [hl|2]. Se suman a la base de [hl|1]: la maceta anda a ×3 y el trigo tarda [hl|20] segundos.
[tip] Una maceta nueva pide la mejora, [hl|5] terracotas, [hl|2] lingotes de hierro y una maceta simple.

sources: jar:botanypotstiers-neoforge-1.21.1-7.0.11.jar:com/ultramega/botanypotstiers/common/impl/item/UpgradeItem.class#useOn (next tier up, keeps the block entity)
repo:pack/kubejs/data/entrelumen/recipe (propagation_core: 2 prudentium essence, living matrix, 2 wax)
jar:botanypots-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.44.jar:net/darkhax/botanypots/common/impl/Helpers.class#getRequiredGrowthTicks (base ticks / (1 + soil + tool + pot modifier)); getTotalYield (1 + pot modifier)

en_us.title: Ultra Upgrade
en_us.subtitle: Act IV, cyan trim.
text: [lead] A cyan band: seven times the speed, four times the harvest.
[big|×7] speed, [big|×4] harvest.
[li] Two [item:minecraft:diamond|Diamonds] flanking an [item:entrelumen:ecosystem_capsule|Ecosystem Capsule].
[li] Sneak-click it on an Elite pot.
[note] The capsule is an act IV delivery: [quest:voices_capsule|A small agreement].
{page}
Wheat takes [hl|20] seconds in an Elite pot and [hl|8.5] in an Ultra.
[tip] A whole new pot takes the upgrade, [hl|5] terracotta, [hl|2] diamonds and an Elite pot.

es_es.title: Mejora Ultra
es_es.subtitle: Acto IV, con ribete cian.
text: [lead] Una franja cian: siete veces la velocidad, cuatro veces la cosecha.
[big|×7] velocidad, [big|×4] cosecha.
[li] Dos [item:minecraft:diamond|Diamantes] a los lados de una [item:entrelumen:ecosystem_capsule|Cápsula de ecosistema].
[li] Clic agachado sobre una maceta Elite.
[note] La cápsula es una entrega del acto IV: [quest:voices_capsule|Un acuerdo pequeño].
{page}
El trigo tarda [hl|20] segundos en una maceta Elite y [hl|8,5] en una Ultra.
[tip] Una maceta nueva pide la mejora, [hl|5] terracotas, [hl|2] diamantes y una maceta Elite.

sources: repo:pack/kubejs/data/entrelumen/recipe (ecosystem_capsule: living matrix, 2 wax, 2 pollen puff)
jar:botanypots-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.44.jar:net/darkhax/botanypots/common/impl/Helpers.class#getRequiredGrowthTicks (base ticks / (1 + soil + tool + pot modifier)); getTotalYield (1 + pot modifier)

en_us.title: Mega Upgrade
en_us.subtitle: Act V, red trim.
text: [lead] A red band: eleven times the speed, five times the harvest.
[big|×11] speed, [big|×5] harvest.
[li] Two [item:minecraft:netherite_ingot|Netherite Ingots] flanking a [item:entrelumen:renewal_engine|Renewal Engine].
[li] Sneak-click it on an Ultra pot.
[note] The engine is an act V delivery: [quest:world_renewal_item|The reserve's engine].
{page}
In the pack's own test, a Mega hopper pot grew wheat in [hl|109] ticks: [hl|5.4] seconds.
[tip] A whole new pot takes the upgrade, [hl|5] terracotta, [hl|2] netherite ingots and an Ultra pot.

es_es.title: Mejora Mega
es_es.subtitle: Acto V, con ribete rojo.
text: [lead] Una franja roja: once veces la velocidad, cinco veces la cosecha.
[big|×11] velocidad, [big|×5] cosecha.
[li] Dos [item:minecraft:netherite_ingot|Lingotes de netherita] a los lados de un [item:entrelumen:renewal_engine|Motor de renovación].
[li] Clic agachado sobre una maceta Ultra.
[note] El motor es una entrega del acto V: [quest:world_renewal_item|El motor de la reserva].
{page}
En la prueba del propio pack, una maceta Mega con tolva hizo crecer trigo en [hl|109] ticks: [hl|5,4] segundos.
[tip] Una maceta nueva pide la mejora, [hl|5] terracotas, [hl|2] lingotes de netherita y una maceta Ultra.

sources: repo:pack/kubejs/data/entrelumen/recipe (renewal_engine: 2 sky ingot, 2 imperium essence, ecosystem capsule, propagation core)
jar:botanypots-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.44.jar:net/darkhax/botanypots/common/impl/Helpers.class#getRequiredGrowthTicks (base ticks / (1 + soil + tool + pot modifier)); getTotalYield (1 + pot modifier)

en_us.title: The Greenhouse
en_us.subtitle: Load it once, then walk away.
text: [lead] A Mega hopper pot over a chest: crop after crop, by itself.
[li] A hopper on a Mega pot, or a Mega upgrade on an Ultra hopper pot.
[li] Soil, seed and tool go in once, by hand.
[li] The chest below takes the rest.
{page}
[note] An upgrade keeps the colour, the hopper and everything inside.

es_es.title: El Invernadero
es_es.subtitle: Cargala una vez y andá tranquilo.
text: [lead] Una maceta Mega con tolva sobre un cofre: cosecha tras cosecha, sola.
[li] Una tolva sobre una maceta Mega, o una mejora Mega sobre una maceta Ultra con tolva.
[li] Tierra, semilla y herramienta entran una vez, a mano.
[li] El cofre de abajo se queda con el resto.
{page}
[note] La mejora conserva el color, la tolva y todo lo que hay adentro.

sources: jar:botanypotstiers-neoforge-1.21.1-7.0.11.jar:com/ultramega/botanypotstiers/common/impl/item/UpgradeItem.class#useOn (contents saved and restored, hopper kept in the block id)

en_us.title: Ground rules
en_us.subtitle: A pot is only as good as its dirt.
text: [lead] The soil decides what can grow in it.
[li] Dirt family: dirt, grass, podzol, mycelium, moss, mud, farmland.
[li] Sand: cactus and sugar cane.
[li] Soul sand or soul soil: nether wart.
[li] End stone: chorus. Sculk: sculk crops.
{page}
Two soils are also faster:
[big|+10%] speed on farmland and on a Sculk Catalyst.
[note] At Mega speed that bonus is a rounding error: +0.1 on top of 11.

es_es.title: Reglas del suelo
es_es.subtitle: Una maceta vale lo que vale su tierra.
text: [lead] El suelo decide qué puede crecer ahí.
[li] Familia de la tierra: tierra, césped, podsol, micelio, musgo, barro, tierra de cultivo.
[li] Arena: cactus y caña de azúcar.
[li] Arena o tierra de almas: verruga del Nether.
[li] Piedra del End: chorus. Sculk: cultivos de sculk.
{page}
Dos suelos, además, son más rápidos:
[big|+10%] de velocidad en tierra de cultivo y en un catalizador de sculk.
[note] A velocidad Mega ese bonus es redondeo: +0,1 sobre 11.

en_us.title: Click the soil
en_us.subtitle: The pot is a workbench too.
text: [lead] Tools and buckets change the soil without taking it out.
[li] Hoe on dirt: farmland. On coarse or rooted dirt: plain dirt.
[li] Shovel on grass, dirt, podzol or mycelium: a dirt path.
{page}
[li] Water bucket on a lava-bucket soil: obsidian. Lava bucket on a water-bucket soil: stone.
[tip] A hoe on rooted dirt also drops hanging roots.

es_es.title: Clic sobre la tierra
es_es.subtitle: La maceta también es un banco de trabajo.
text: [lead] Herramientas y baldes cambian el suelo sin sacarlo.
[li] Azada sobre tierra: tierra de cultivo. Sobre tierra estéril o enraizada: tierra común.
[li] Pala sobre césped, tierra, podsol o micelio: un camino de tierra.
{page}
[li] Cubo con agua sobre un suelo de cubo con lava: obsidiana. Cubo con lava sobre un suelo de cubo con agua: piedra.
[tip] Una azada sobre tierra enraizada suelta además raíces colgantes.

en_us.title: The tool slot
en_us.subtitle: The pot borrows your hoe.
text: [lead] The third slot takes a hoe or shears, and that tool judges the harvest.
[li:minecraft:shears] [item:minecraft:shears|Shears]: trees drop their leaves.
[li] Efficiency: [hl|+5%] growth speed per level.
[li] Fortune counts for crops whose loot asks for it.
[careful] Each harvest wears the tool down.
{page}
The Curse of Idle Hands stops the wear, and leaves the tool useless in your hands.
[note] Librarians can sell it.

es_es.title: La ranura de herramienta
es_es.subtitle: La maceta te pide prestada la azada.
text: [lead] La tercera ranura acepta una azada o tijeras, y esa herramienta juzga la cosecha.
[li:minecraft:shears] [item:minecraft:shears|Tijeras]: los árboles sueltan sus hojas.
[li] Eficiencia: [hl|+5%] de velocidad de crecimiento por nivel.
[li] Fortuna cuenta en los cultivos cuyo botín la pide.
[careful] Cada cosecha desgasta la herramienta.
{page}
La Maldición de manos ociosas frena el desgaste y deja la herramienta inservible en tus manos.
[note] Los bibliotecarios pueden venderla.

en_us.title: Bone meal helps
text: [tip] Bone meal on a growing pot skips [hl|400] to [hl|600] ticks, up to ready.
[li:minecraft:bone_meal] Plain wheat takes two or three; in an Elite pot, one.

es_es.title: El polvo de hueso ayuda
text: [tip] El polvo de hueso sobre una maceta que crece salta de [hl|400] a [hl|600] ticks, hasta dejarla lista.
[li:minecraft:bone_meal] El trigo común pide dos o tres; en una maceta Elite, uno.

en_us.title: Read the growth
text: [tip] A comparator beside a pot reads it: the signal climbs while the crop grows and hits [hl|15] when it is ready.
Enough to switch a lamp on, or a farm off.

es_es.title: Leer el crecimiento
text: [tip] Un comparador junto a la maceta la lee: la señal sube mientras el cultivo crece y llega a [hl|15] cuando está listo.
Alcanza para prender una lámpara o apagar una granja.

sources: jar:botanypots-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.44.jar:net/darkhax/botanypots/common/impl/block/entity/BotanyPotBlockEntity.class#tickPot (updateComparatorLevel 15 when grown, ceil(14 x progress) while growing)

en_us.title: Frozen in bloom
en_us.subtitle: Honeycomb turns a pot into a statue.
text: [lead] Wax a pot and its plant stays at full growth for good.
[li] A [item:minecraft:honeycomb|Honeycomb] and a pot, shapeless: a [item:botanypots:terracotta_waxed_botany_pot|Waxed Botany Pot].
[li] Nothing goes in and nothing comes out.
[tip] Wax a full pot for the display shelf.

es_es.title: Congelada en flor
es_es.subtitle: El panal vuelve estatua a la maceta.
text: [lead] Encerá una maceta y su planta queda crecida para siempre.
[li] Un [item:minecraft:honeycomb|Panal] y una maceta, sin forma: una [item:botanypots:terracotta_waxed_botany_pot|Maceta botánica encerada].
[li] Nada entra y nada sale.
[tip] Encerá una maceta llena para el estante de exhibición.

en_us.title: Empty from below
en_us.subtitle: Nothing goes in from outside.
text: [lead] Hopper pots empty through the bottom face, and only through it.
[li] A chest, a hopper or a pipe under the pot takes the harvest.
[li] Soil, seed and tool can only be loaded by hand.
[li] Basic pots have no automatic output at all.
{page}
[note] Pipes and routers: [chapter:sector_logistics|Logistics Networks] and [chapter:sector_routers|Modular Routers].

es_es.title: Vaciar desde abajo
es_es.subtitle: Desde afuera no entra nada.
text: [lead] Las macetas con tolva se vacían por la cara de abajo, y sólo por ahí.
[li] Un cofre, una tolva o un caño bajo la maceta se lleva la cosecha.
[li] Tierra, semilla y herramienta sólo se cargan a mano.
[li] Las macetas simples no tienen salida automática.
{page}
[note] Caños y routers: [chapter:sector_logistics|Redes de logística] y [chapter:sector_routers|Modular Routers].

en_us.title: Buckets are soil
en_us.subtitle: Yes, a bucket of cod works.
text: [lead] A water bucket is a valid soil, and so is any bucket of fish.
[li] [item:minecraft:kelp|Kelp], [item:minecraft:seagrass|Seagrass] and [item:minecraft:sea_pickle|Sea Pickle].
[li] Corals and coral fans.
[li] [item:minecraft:lily_pad|Lily Pads].
[note] Salmon, cod, tropical fish, pufferfish, axolotl and tadpole buckets all count.

es_es.title: El balde es la tierra
es_es.subtitle: Sí, un balde con bacalao sirve.
text: [lead] Un cubo con agua es un suelo válido, y también cualquier cubo con pescado.
[li] [item:minecraft:kelp|Alga], [item:minecraft:seagrass|Hierba marina] y [item:minecraft:sea_pickle|Pepino de mar].
[li] Corales y abanicos de coral.
[li] [item:minecraft:lily_pad|Nenúfares].
[note] Cubos con salmón, bacalao, pez tropical, pez globo, ajolote y renacuajo también cuentan.

en_us.title: The Nether on a shelf
en_us.subtitle: No fortress required.
text: [lead] Soul soil and nylium turn a pot into a piece of the Nether.
[li:minecraft:nether_wart] [item:minecraft:nether_wart|Nether Wart] grows on soul sand or soul soil.
[li] Fungus and roots take nylium or netherrack.
[li] Crimson fungus also drops [hl|5%] shroomlight and [hl|5%] wart blocks.
{page}
Past the Nether: [item:minecraft:chorus_flower|Chorus Flower] on [item:minecraft:end_stone|End Stone] gives chorus fruit and, now and then, another flower.

es_es.title: El Nether en un estante
es_es.subtitle: Sin fortaleza de por medio.
text: [lead] Tierra de almas y necelio vuelven a una maceta un pedazo del Nether.
[li:minecraft:nether_wart] La [item:minecraft:nether_wart|Verruga del Nether] crece en arena o tierra de almas.
[li] Hongos y raíces piden necelio o netherrack.
[li] El hongo carmesí suelta además [hl|5%] de brillongo y [hl|5%] de bloques de verrugas.
{page}
Más allá del Nether: la [item:minecraft:chorus_flower|Flor chorus] sobre [item:minecraft:end_stone|Piedra del End] da fruta chorus y, de vez en cuando, otra flor.

en_us.title: A sculk garden
en_us.subtitle: The Warden is not invited.
text: [lead] Sculk grows on sculk: farm it without a Warden in sight.
[li] Soil: [item:minecraft:sculk|Sculk] or a [item:minecraft:sculk_catalyst|Sculk Catalyst].
[li] Sculk takes [hl|2] minutes; catalyst, sensor and shrieker crops, [hl|5].
[li] Each harvest: sculk, plus [hl|15%] catalyst, [hl|5%] sensor and [hl|5%] shrieker.
{page}
[tip] The Echo Tree of Deeper and Darker grows on sculk too.

es_es.title: Un jardín de sculk
es_es.subtitle: El Warden no está invitado.
text: [lead] El sculk crece sobre sculk: cultivalo sin un Warden a la vista.
[li] Suelo: [item:minecraft:sculk|Sculk] o un [item:minecraft:sculk_catalyst|Catalizador de sculk].
[li] El sculk tarda [hl|2] minutos; los cultivos de catalizador, sensor y chillador, [hl|5].
[li] Cada cosecha: sculk, más [hl|15%] de catalizador, [hl|5%] de sensor y [hl|5%] de chillador.
{page}
[tip] El Árbol del eco de Deeper and Darker también crece sobre sculk.

en_us.title: Fibres, oil and dreams
en_us.subtitle: Field crops that keep the machines fed.
text: [lead] Industry's crops grow in pots too.
[li:immersiveengineering:textures/item/material_hemp_fiber.png] Hemp: [quest:iet_hemp|Industrial hemp].
[li] Flax, from Silent Gear and Actually Additions: [quest:sg_fibers|Flax].
[li] Canola: [quest:aa_canola|Canola oil].
[li] [item:occultism:datura|Demon's Dream]: [quest:occ_seeds|Demon's Dream].
{page}
[tip] Put a Fortune tool in the tool slot: hemp, flax and canola ask for it.

es_es.title: Fibras, aceite y sueños
es_es.subtitle: Cultivos de campo para alimentar las máquinas.
text: [lead] Los cultivos de la industria también crecen en macetas.
[li:immersiveengineering:textures/item/material_hemp_fiber.png] Cáñamo: [quest:iet_hemp|Cáñamo industrial].
[li] Lino, de Silent Gear y de Actually Additions: [quest:sg_fibers|Lino].
[li] Canola: [quest:aa_canola|Aceite de canola].
[li] [item:occultism:datura|Fruta de sueño demoníaco]: [quest:occ_seeds|Sueño demoníaco].
{page}
[tip] Poné una herramienta con Fortuna en la ranura: el cáñamo, el lino y la canola la piden.

en_us.title: A garden of hundreds
en_us.subtitle: Most of the pack's farms already fit a pot.
text: [lead] Most crop mods in the pack ship a pot recipe.
[li] [hl|200] Pam's HarvestCraft crops and [hl|121] from Herbs and Harvest.
[li] Farmer's Delight: rice, tomato, cabbage, onion and their wild forms.
[li] Sushi Go: cucumber, rice, sesame, soy and wasabi.
{page}
[note] Croptopia's crops are off in this pack: its pot recipes use a pre-1.21 format that no longer loads.
The rest of the garden: [chapter:sector_farm_fields|Farm · Crops and Trees].

es_es.title: Un jardín de cientos
es_es.subtitle: La mayoría de las granjas del pack entran en una maceta.
text: [lead] La mayoría de los mods de cultivos del pack traen su receta de maceta.
[li] [hl|200] cultivos de Pam's HarvestCraft y [hl|121] de Herbs and Harvest.
[li] Farmer's Delight: arroz, tomate, repollo, cebolla y sus versiones silvestres.
[li] Sushi Go: pepino, arroz, sésamo, soja y wasabi.
{page}
[note] Los cultivos de Croptopia están apagados en este pack: sus recetas de maceta usan un formato anterior a la 1.21 que ya no carga.
El resto del jardín: [chapter:sector_farm_fields|Granja · Cultivos y árboles].

en_us.title: Essence farms elsewhere
text: [tip] Mystical Agriculture has its own fields: [chapter:sector_ma_essence|Essence] for seeds and tiers, [chapter:sector_ma_greenhouse|Greenhouse] for the harvester and machines.

es_es.title: La esencia se cultiva aparte
text: [tip] Mystical Agriculture tiene sus propios campos: [chapter:sector_ma_essence|Esencia] para semillas y niveles, [chapter:sector_ma_greenhouse|Invernadero] para la cosechadora y las máquinas.

en_us.title: A forest in a pot
en_us.subtitle: Botany Trees: no axe required.
text: [lead] A sapling in a pot yields wood every two minutes.
[li] Trees take [hl|2] minutes, twice a crop.
[li] [hl|1 to 4] [item:minecraft:oak_log|Oak Logs] per harvest.
[li:minecraft:textures/block/oak_sapling.png] A [hl|5%] chance of another sapling.
[li] With shears in the tool slot: [hl|1 to 3] leaves.
{page}
Oak also drops an apple [hl|5%] of the time. All eight vanilla trees work, mangrove included.
[note] Trees take the same dirt-type soils as crops.

es_es.title: Un bosque en una maceta
es_es.subtitle: Botany Trees: sin hacha.
text: [lead] Un brote en una maceta da madera cada dos minutos.
[li] Los árboles tardan [hl|2] minutos, el doble que un cultivo.
[li] [hl|1 a 4] [item:minecraft:oak_log|Troncos de roble] por cosecha.
[li:minecraft:textures/block/oak_sapling.png] [hl|5%] de chance de otro brote.
[li] Con tijeras en la ranura de herramienta: [hl|1 a 3] hojas.
{page}
El roble suelta además una manzana el [hl|5%] de las veces. Andan los ocho árboles de vanilla, el de mangle incluido.
[note] Los árboles usan los mismos suelos de la familia de la tierra que los cultivos.

sources: jar:botanytrees-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.7.jar:data/botanytrees/recipe/minecraft/ (acacia, birch, cherry, dark_oak, jungle, mangrove, oak, spruce)

en_us.title: Woods with a secret
en_us.subtitle: The bonus is in the drops.
text: [lead] Modded trees give their log plus a rare extra.
[li] [quest:malum_runewood|Runewood]: [hl|5%] exposed logs. Soulwood: [hl|5%] Blight and Blighted Gunk.
[li] [quest:idy_grove|Menril]: [hl|15%] berries, one to four.
[li] [quest:sg_netherwood|Netherwood]: [hl|5%] nether banana.
{page}

These plain-log trees also grow in a pot: the four [quest:arsspell_archwood|Archwoods] and Ars Elemental's yellow one, [quest:fa_flora|Aurum], [quest:occ_otherworld_log|Otherworld] and [quest:evil_undead|Undead].

es_es.title: Maderas con secreto
es_es.subtitle: El extra viene en el botín.
text: [lead] Los árboles de mods dan su tronco y, a veces, un extra.
[li] [quest:malum_runewood|Runewood]: [hl|5%] de troncos expuestos. Soulwood: [hl|5%] de Blight y de Residuos Marchitos.
[li] [quest:idy_grove|Menril]: [hl|15%] de bayas, de una a cuatro.
[li] [quest:sg_netherwood|Madera del Nether]: [hl|5%] de banana del Nether.
{page}

Estos árboles de tronco común también crecen en maceta: las cuatro [quest:arsspell_archwood|Archwood] y la amarilla de Ars Elemental, el [quest:fa_flora|Aurum], el [quest:occ_otherworld_log|Otherworld] y el [quest:evil_undead|no-muerto].

en_us.title: Woods from other worlds
en_us.subtitle: Saplings are the souvenir.
text: [lead] Bring a sapling home from another dimension.
[li] [quest:sl_saplings|Eternal Starlight]: seven woods; the lunar tree gives [hl|5%] berries.
[li] Aether: skyroot, and golden oak with [hl|5%] golden amber.
[li] [quest:ug_woods|Undergarden]: three woods; grongle drops [hl|5%] gronglets.
[li] Twilight Forest: ten trees.
{page}
[note] The Echo Tree of Deeper and Darker needs a sculk soil. The rest take dirt.

es_es.title: Maderas de otros mundos
es_es.subtitle: El souvenir es el brote.
text: [lead] Traé un brote de otra dimensión.
[li] [quest:sl_saplings|Eternal Starlight]: siete maderas; el árbol lunar da [hl|5%] de bayas.
[li] Aether: raicielo, y roble dorado con [hl|5%] de ámbar dorado.
[li] [quest:ug_woods|Undergarden]: tres maderas; el grongle suelta [hl|5%] de gronglets.
[li] Twilight Forest: diez árboles.
{page}
[note] El Árbol del eco de Deeper and Darker pide un suelo de sculk. El resto, tierra.

en_us.title: Timber for the common store
en_us.subtitle: Straight off the shelf.
text: [lead] For the common store, once a day.
[big|64] [item:minecraft:oak_log|Oak Logs].
An upgraded hopper pot over a chest fills it while you do something else.

es_es.title: Madera para el depósito común
es_es.subtitle: Directo del estante.
text: [lead] Para el depósito común, una vez por día.
[big|64] [item:minecraft:oak_log|Troncos de roble].
Una maceta mejorada con tolva sobre un cofre lo llena mientras hacés otra cosa.

en_us.title: Loud neighbours
en_us.subtitle: Five percent, patiently.
text: [lead] A sculk pot rolled a [item:minecraft:sculk_shrieker|Sculk Shrieker].
[hl|5%] per harvest, and not an Ancient City in sight.

es_es.title: Vecinos ruidosos
es_es.subtitle: Cinco por ciento, con paciencia.
text: [lead] Una maceta de sculk tiró un [item:minecraft:sculk_shrieker|Chillador de sculk].
[hl|5%] por cosecha, y ni rastro de una Ciudad Ancestral.

en_us.title: A banana from the Nether
en_us.subtitle: It grows on a tree. Of course it does.
text: [lead] A netherwood tree in a pot dropped a [item:silentgear:nether_banana|Nether Banana].
[hl|5%] per harvest.

es_es.title: Una banana del Nether
es_es.subtitle: Crece en un árbol. Obvio que sí.
text: [lead] Un árbol de madera del Nether en una maceta soltó una [item:silentgear:nether_banana|Banana del Nether].
[hl|5%] por cosecha.

en_us.title: Switch on the grow lamps
en_us.subtitle: Plants like a night shift.
text: [lead] Five lamps under the roof.
Nothing to build here. Just a switch.

es_es.title: Prendé las lámparas de cultivo
es_es.subtitle: A las plantas les gusta el turno noche.
text: [lead] Cinco lámparas bajo el techo.
Acá no hay nada que fabricar. Sólo un interruptor.
